`main.wj` is written and builds with `wj run --compiled`. On Example 1 it prints `1`, `evict 2`, `-1`, `3 1`, which matches the expected output.

I didn't run Example 2 or any other inputs, such as an empty cache for `<empty>`.

The cache is two parallel vectors, one of keys and one of values, ordered from least to most recently used. A `put` or `get` removes the key and pushes it back to the end.
